records.title: compare-mt: A Tool for Holistic Comparison of Language Generation Systems
records.reason: Language-generation comparison tool, an evaluation utility rather than an inference method.

records.title: Let It Flow: Agentic Crafting on Rock and Roll, Building the ROME Model within an Open Agentic Learning Ecosystem
records.reason: ROME presents an open agentic learning ecosystem and a model/tool workflow; evaluation centers on agent-learning capability rather than inference-serving systems metrics. Runtime applicability to agent serving is plausible but indirect.

records.title: OPID: On-Policy Skill Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: On-policy skill distillation studies agent training, not inference-system efficiency.

records.title: State of AI: An Empirical 100 Trillion Token Study with OpenRouter
records.reason: The study analyzes a large OpenRouter token dataset and empirical model usage patterns, with results about workload/model mix. It provides context for memory-aware placement and scheduling but does not propose or evaluate a serving optimization itself; request population and telemetry coverage bound generalization.

records.title: LongCat-Flash-Thinking-2601 Technical Report
records.reason: LongCat-Flash-Thinking is a technical report on a model and training/inference design, including a Zig-Zag attention design and context-management components. The report ties these to model capability; system-level serving benefits need controlled component attribution and independent replication.
